title: Affluent (TON) permissionless unbacked share mint — redeem leg empty; CA2's $1.34M is pool TVL, not extractable
closed_reasons: Every burn emulation (1 raw .. 1e16, both vaults) refunds the burned shares via 0x178d4519 (from="") and emits NO 0x0f8a7ea5 / 0xb2a4c51b / 0xcb03bfaf payout.
affUSDTl vault idle balance = 1 raw; affTONl = 0; the burn path is capped at the idle balance, not at the $1.013M pool-supply NAV.
The $1.34M CA2 figure is DefiLlama pool TVL (sum supplied-borrowed over 8 pools = $1,282,377.28 today), not the vaults' redeemable NAV.
The vaults' own claims are $19,810.62 (affUSDTl) + $993,489.39 (affTONl) = $1,013,300.01, held as whitelisted-pool supplyAmount; the burn path cannot reach them.

Vault shares are listed as collateral only in LendingVaultPool 0:5030..., where all 5 assets have isBorrowable=0; the pools with borrowable USDT/TON (AdvancedPool, Storm, Ethena, Tradoor) do not list the shares. No simultaneous collateral+borrowable-asset pool -> borrow path $0.
No DEX market for the shares; share prices are ~4.34e-7 USD/token (affUSDTl) and 0.011483 TON/token (affTONl).
Owner 0:acb28b15... and manager 0:0e648438... are `nonexist` (undeployed, balance 0, never acted); no privileged recovery demonstrated.
key_facts: Mint primitive real and unpatched: any wallet -> pool 0x7362d09c -> 0xa1b21e8b -> vault mints 0x178d4519 with from="" to arbitrary beneficiary/amount (CA2 root cause re-confirmed).

Mint re-run today (2026-11-03): both the historical sender 0:3446... and a fresh 0:1111... cause the AdvancedPool to relay to the USDT vault, which mints 1e16 affUSDTl to beneficiary wallet 0:9c2f... with from=""; the mint is live and permissionless today.
12/12 fresh burn emulations (amounts 1, 1e6, 1e9, 1e15, 1e16 plus full balances 3e16 affUSDTl / 2e16 affTONl) are REFUND-ONLY.
The exact 2026-10-16 attacker wallet 0:c5d3... still holds 5,697,376,531,863,130 affUSDTl; burning it today refunds, pays 0.
Large-holder burn of 9,999,999,999,999,999 affUSDTl on 2026-10-18 (event 66e93afd125d4120...) paid 0 USD; only 0.0683 TON gas change.

caveats: Live emulation uses tonapi's hosted TVM (/v2/traces/emulate): execution, not replay/broadcast; a host-side emulator difference cannot be fully excluded. The saved 2026-10-16 trace and the independent 2026-10-18 large-holder burn corroborate.
The exact failing gate (idle `balance` vs aggregator state) is inferred from the vault storage layout and traces; the economic result (0 payout, 12/12) is measured.

P and S are mutually exclusive on the same $1,013,300.01: P is possible only if the owner/manager key is live and a withdrawal path exists; those accounts are currently `nonexist` and have never acted, so S is the observed state. Do not add P and S.

E-U-conditional ($1,013,300.01) requires (a) the vault idle balance to be re-funded or the burn->aggregator path restored, and (b) the attacker to mint enough shares to dilute existing holders (beneficiary holds 65.6% affUSDTl / 26.7% affTONl). Neither holds today.
TON priced at $1.155512 (DefiLlama, 2026-11-03 1793712089); USDT at $0.998495. Different prices change the USD NAV modestly.
The $1.34M CA2 figure was the 2026-11-02 DefiLlama snapshot; today's TVL is $1,282,377.28. The difference is price/other lenders, not vault NAV.

Report snapshot prices: TON $1.155512 / USDT $0.998495 (ts 1793712089), NAV $1,013,300.01. A repeat minutes later at TON $1.158156 gives $19,808.73 + $995,762.34 = $1,015,571.07 (ci-out/measurement.json); the ~0.2% difference is price, not position.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can mint unlimited Affluent vault shares (re-confirmed live today from a fresh wallet) but cannot redeem them — 12/12 burns (incl. the exact 2026-10-16 attacker wallet) refund with no payout; $0.00 extractable today; CA2's $1.34M is DefiLlama pool TVL, not vault NAV; the $1.013M vault NAV is frozen (S/P).
